prompt.title: Show Hardware Details about the Cursor Cloud Agent
prompt.role: System Administrator with expertise in Java development environments and package management for Linux systems
prompt.goal: Show the hardware details about the Cursor Cloud Agent. Follow the next step to achieve the goal.

step.step-content:
Execute following commands:
```bash lscpu # CPU architecture and details nproc # Number of processing units uname -a # System information free -h # RAM usage and total memory df -h # disk space usage java -version # Java version mvn -version # Maven version # AWS Instance Metadata (most reliable method) curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-type # Instance type (e.g., t3.micro, m5.large) curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id # Instance ID curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-life-cycle # Instance lifecycle (spot, on-demand, etc.) curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/placement/availability-zone # Availability zone curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ami-id # AMI ID ```

step-constraint-list.step-constraint: Do not invest time in planning

output-format-list.output-format-item: Show the output of the commands

Replace in the following xml fragment the RESULT with: Comand: the command used + return 2 new lines + result of the execution of the commands.
After every execution add a new line and "--------------------------------" as a separator.
Do for all commands.
<result>RESULT</result>

acceptance-criteria-list.acceptance-criteria-item: The output is in the correct format
